title: 道教經典白話翻譯集 / Daoist Canon Vernacular Translation Dataset
description:
1,275 Daoist scriptures (17,081 chapters), each in three parallel columns: original classical Chinese text + modern vernacular translation + scholarly annotation. Browse: https://lius.cc/canon

Original texts are in the public domain (based on 道藏 / 雲笈七籤 / 王弼本 etc.). The vernacular translations, prefaces, and scholarly annotations are original works by Dingren Daoxue Academy, released under CC0 1.0. v0.1 is a pre-peer-review, preprint-style release.

creators.name: Liu, Chi-Ying
creators.affiliation: Dingren Daoxue Academy, Liu-Cuo Pai Dingxin Men (劉厝派鼎新門 鼎稔道學館)
